title: orchestra design-repo
description: Shape contract for the design-repo files. The validator (design-repo/schema/validate-design-repo.mjs) checks these shapes AND cross-file referential integrity, which a pure JSON Schema cannot express.

section.description: Must resolve to a key in sections.json when present.

invariants: Every components[*].section resolves to a key in sections.json.
Every sections[*].implementedBy points at a file that exists on disk.
Every templates[*].sections[*] resolves to a key in sections.json.
Every color referenced by a primitive's CSS exists in tokens.json.
sections.json and templates.json stay in sync with the root ia.json (they are derived from it).
conversion.cta-band is rendered only by Footer, never by a page component.
